summary: Frontier Nuclear and Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a press release and scrutineer's report announcing results of its 2026 Annual General Special Meeting held August 25, 2026. Shareholders fixed the board at six directors, elected the six nominees, and re-appointed De Visser Gray LLP as auditor. No special-situation transaction or strategic event is described; it is a routine annual meeting disclosure by a foreign private issuer.
